newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Stockpile sells palladium, no platinum award.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Stockpile sells palladium, no platinum award.

text.p: The Defense National Stockpile Center said it sold 15,000 troy ounces of palladium to Degussa Corp for a total of $2,214,282.
This was the first sale of palladium by the stockpile and the amount represented all the metal available in the current fiscal year.
Nine companies had sought to buy the stockpiled palladium but Degussa was the only one to offer a premium over the London fix - the other bidders all offered a price below this level.
No awards were made following the platinum offer, also the first by the stockpile. The DNSC has some 10,188 troy ounces for sale in the current fiscal year and the next offer will be on April 28.
Eight companies had bid for platinum, all at a discount to the London afternoon fix.
